slides.title: Spoken Tutorial on Predictive vs. Generative AI
slides.narration: Welcome to this Spoken Tutorial on **Predictive** vs. **Generative AI**.

slides.title: Learning Objectives
slides.narration:
In this tutorial, you will learn to,

• Define **Predictive AI**.
• Define **Generative AI**.
• Identify their key differences.
• Explain the **Transformer architecture**.

slides.title: System Requirements
slides.narration: Here I am using a browser on a computer or mobile.

slides.title: Prerequisites
slides.narration:
To follow this tutorial, you should have a basic understanding of **AI** concepts.
Please refer to our website for more detail.

slides.title: What is Predictive AI? Think of it like a weather forecast.
slides.narration:
What is **Predictive AI**?
It uses existing data to make informed predictions.
Think of it like a weather forecast.
It predicts rain or sun based on past patterns.
Similarly, **Predictive AI** forecasts outcomes.
slides.image_prompt: Person at laptop, weather forecast map with rain and sun icons

slides.title: Demo: Predictive AI - Email Spam Detection
slides.narration:
Let's see a demo of **Predictive AI**.
Imagine your email inbox.
It classifies emails as spam or not spam.
It learns from millions of past emails.
This helps keep your inbox clean.
slides.image_prompt: Screen close-up: email inbox with a spam email highlighted

slides.title: What is Generative AI? Think of it like an artist creating a new painting.
slides.narration:
What about **Generative AI**?
It creates brand new, original content.
Think of it like an artist painting.
The artist creates a unique piece of art.
**Generative AI** can create text, images, or music.
slides.image_prompt: Person at laptop, digital artist painting on a tablet

slides.title: Demo: Generative AI - Text Generation
slides.narration:
Now, let's watch **Generative AI** in action.
We will give it a small prompt.
See how it creates a unique story.
Or perhaps even a poem.
It shows its ability to produce new content.
slides.image_prompt: Screen close-up: user typing 'Write a short story about...' into a text generation AI

slides.title: Real-Life Example: Online Shopping Recommendations
slides.narration:
Let's see this in a real-life example.
Open any online shopping app on your phone.
Browse for a new shirt or a book.
The app predicts items you might like.
This is based on your past purchases.
This is **Predictive AI** at work.
It can also generate product descriptions.
This describes new items for sale.
That is **Generative AI**.
slides.image_prompt: Person using a mobile phone, online shopping app showing product recommendations and generated product descriptions

slides.title: Predictive vs. Generative: Classification vs. Creation
slides.narration:
What is the key difference?
**Predictive AI** classifies or forecasts existing data.
Think of sorting items into bins.
**Generative AI** creates entirely new content.
Imagine an inventor making something new.
It's classification versus creation.
slides.image_prompt: Side-by-side: left side showing items being sorted into bins (Predictive AI), right side showing an artist creating a new sculpture (Generative AI)

slides.title: What is Transformer Architecture? Think of it like a meticulous editor.
slides.narration:
Let's talk about **Transformer architecture**.
It's an **AI** breakthrough.
It helps models understand context.
Think of a meticulous editor.
An editor understands text relationships.
This makes **AI** models more effective.
slides.image_prompt: Person at laptop, close-up of text being edited with highlighted connections, representing Transformer architecture

slides.title: Summary
slides.narration:
Let us summarize what we learned.
We covered **Predictive AI** for prediction.
We also learned about **Generative AI** for creation.
We saw their core differences.
Finally, we understood **Transformer architecture** for context-awareness.

slides.title: Assignment
slides.narration:
Now as an assignment,
Explore examples of **Predictive AI** in daily life.
For instance, email filters.
Also, find **Generative AI** examples like chatbots.
Note their distinct functions.
Compare the results.
